summary: A youth in a ruined city under blood-red rain hunts a vulture eating a dead dog. He kills it with a metal rod, retrieves his kill, then moves on through the desolate city. He finds an apothecary shop with rotting herbs and treats a wound on his chest using a golden medicinal plant.

recent_events.description: Youth hunts and kills a vulture with a metal rod; retrieves corpse and weapon; finds abandoned apothecary; treats chest wound with medicinal herb
